fieldTypes.description: Field type parameters. Keys are field types.

select.description: Fields of the type are available for selection in the UI for the 'select' action. Find feature, fields that can be selected.

filter.description: Fields of the type are available for selection in the UI for the 'filter' action. Find feature, fields that can be used in search.

read.description: Fields of the type are available for selection in the UI for the 'read' action. Read feature, fields that can be selected.

create.description: Fields of the type are available for selection in the UI for the 'create' action. Create feature, fields that can be written.

update.description: Fields of the type are available for selection in the UI for the 'update' action. Update feature, fields that can be written.

schemaProviderClassName.description: A field schema provider class.  Should implement `Espo\Modules\Mcp\Tools\Schema\Field\SchemaProvider`.

filterSchemaProviderClassName.description: A field filter schema provider class. Should implement `Espo\Modules\Mcp\Tools\Schema\FieldFilter\SchemaProvider`.
